verdict.rationale: Secureframe runs its own background automations, including continuous daily monitoring with alerts and automated evidence collection through integrations. Users can configure recurring schedules for access reviews and risk-based vendor reviews. These are fixed, built-in compliance jobs and human-review cadences, not a user-defined automation or agent workflow builder. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable automation or workflow builder, autonomous AI-agent tasks that run unattended in the background, custom triggers and actions, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Continuous daily monitoring of your compliance status with alerts for failing tests.
use recurring schedules, reminders, and status indicators to keep the process moving
